# Causal_Emergence

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where higher-level macro-states exhibit stronger causal relationships than the underlying micro-dynamics, enabling effective coarse-grained control. Enables efficient hierarchical processing in TCC/iNEST by allowing networks to operate on emergent causal structures rather than raw data streams.
